Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner overcomplicated a simple comparative task after sufficient information (1963 vs. 1995) was already available to answer which film was earlier. Instead of concluding, the Planner repeatedly insisted on gathering “earliest release date and country” details, causing redundant loops and failing to recognize that the confirmed years alone resolved the question. This unnecessary scope expansion stalled progress and risked confusion, matching the pattern of over-specifying and repeating instructions despite adequate data.
